## Family-adjusted contrasts

Six left-minus-right no-evidence pass@10 comparisons per family, each endpoint using six cases and 20 repeats. The 5% family error budget is split across 12 endpoint intervals. Coverage below means all six true differences were contained at once.

| Family | Simultaneous coverage (MC interval) | Mean contrast width |
|---|---|---:|
| six-null-pairs | 1.0000 (0.9996, 1.0000) | 1.4737 |
| six-mixed-pairs | 1.0000 (0.9996, 1.0000) | 1.3606 |

## Reproduction and limits

The companion JSON contains every setting, exact input/source hashes, Python/NumPy versions, coverage, widths and Monte Carlo standard errors. `validation-spec.json` records all settings before simulation. Invalid responses occupy the fifth category in multinomial experiments. Heterogeneous correctness probabilities represent different case difficulties; relabeling truth categories leaves this score unchanged.

The diagnostic fails if any in-scope coverage estimate is more than 0.005 below 0.95. Diagnostic: **pass**.
